newsitem.title: CANADA: St. Lawrence Seaway Authority says reopens April 2.
newsitem.headline: St. Lawrence Seaway Authority says reopens April 2.

text.p: The St. Lawrence Seaway's Welland Canal and Lake Ontario-Montreal sections were scheduled to reopen at 0800 EST/1300 GMT Wednesday April 2, a St. Lawrence Seaway Authority spokeswoman said.
"The Seaway's scheduled to reopen on April 2," Authority spokeswoman Sylvie Moncion told Reuters in French.
Ship movements will depend on temperature and ice conditions, Moncion said.
An assessment of ice thickness and water levels will be done the first week of March and an advisory should be issued March 10 in regards to the opening date.
The Seaway is a 38-year-old 2,300-km channel between the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River.
